redscript.reason: Current Biology runtime uses narrow additive/wrapper seams. REDmod script replacement is a whole vanilla-path file route and would broaden patch/conflict surface for those seams. Runtime integration remains owned by the runtime lanes and must be packaged only after their accepted file set is known.

rules: The REDmod package identity is Biology and lives under mods/Biology.
Foundation package construction must not modify a Cyberpunk installation.
Only files enumerated by this contract may enter the REDmod-native payload.

A non-REDmod runtime file may enter a future integrated release only when manifest/dependency-graph.json names its concrete Biology consumer and manifest/redmod-classification.json records an accepted route.
No Dark Future or Project E3 executing content may enter the package.
No stock Cyberpunk executable, archive, script bundle, save, settings file, or other proprietary game payload may enter the package.
The installed REDmod 2.31 CLI/tool path is directly probed, but Biology package recognition/deployment and relaunch persistence remain direct-game gates until actually exercised.
